amendments.reason: observation_operators.mycelial_area tied the detection density to the model cell (one segment per cell side), which made the area observable change with the grid and the plan's own grid-convergence check ill-posed; found while building stage 0, before any check was recorded or any fit run. The detection density is now a declared constant, 1 per millimetre, independent of the grid. No model, bound, rule, hold-out or other setting changed.

The first recorded stage 0 (kept in results/stage_0_superseded_ea6e2e72) failed its grid check (largest relative difference 0.574 in tip count, 0.102 in area, threshold 0.02) and its symmetry check (0.760 and 0.192, threshold 0.03) while the solver check passed (3.6e-6). A probe traced the failure to the model: the active translocation term D_a s grad(n) carries internal reserve up the tip-density gradient and branching makes tips where the reserve is, a chemotaxis-like positive feedback that concentrates tips into a spike whose height grows without bound as the cell shrinks (24 h tip count 27669, 64922, 146399 on 141, 283, 566 radial cells at D_a = 1; 1434, 1301, 1161 with the peak density quadrupling per halving at D_a = 0.1); with D_a = 1e-4 the same model converges (9617, 9531, 9531). A fit over the declared D_a bounds could exploit that grid artifact. Amendment 2, before any fit: the active term and its parameter D_a are removed from colony_reserve_v1 (translocation is diffusive only); a well-posedness guard re-solves every scored solution on the doubled radial grid with the grid threshold, and decision rule R0 makes a failure 'not run (not grid converged)'; the symmetry threshold the plan already stated in prose (3 percent) is made machine-readable. No other model term, bound, operator, hold-out, stage or rule changed.

The stage 0 re-run under amendment 2 (kept in results/stage_0_superseded_ca0e016c) passed its grid check (5.3e-05 in tip count, 0.0056 in area) and its solver check (1.1e-07) and failed its symmetry check (0.382 in tip count, 0.059 in area against 0.03). The radial and cartesian models agreed within 1 to 3 percent until the colony reached the window edge at about 12 h and then diverged, because the two domains differ there: the cartesian reference was the 40 mm window with walls that reflect tips back into it, and the radial domain ended at the window's half-diagonal, 28.3 mm, with a wall of its own. Neither wall is physical: the window is the scanner's field of view inside a larger dish. A probe showed the 28.3 mm wall changes the window tip count by 0.46 relative to a 45 mm domain, while a 90 mm domain differs from the 45 mm one by less than 0.001 in tips until 36 h and by at most 0.041 (tips, at 62 h, as tips reach the dish wall) and 0.0052 (area), so the declared dish wall matters only late in the 62 h. The radial tip front leads the detected hull by about 4.7 mm (99.9 percent of tips within 21.35 mm when the hull is at 16.65 mm, 14 h), so the comparison window is set by the tips: at most 0.1 percent of the radial tips beyond the window half side, which on the 45 mm reference admits hours 1 to 12; this criterion was recorded before any cartesian result at a finer cell was available. Over those hours the 0.5 mm cartesian reference differs from the radial model by up to 0.027 in tip count and 0.058 in area, the area difference largest at 2 h when the colony is smallest, consistent with the hull being quantised to cell centres, which scales with the cell; the reference cell is therefore halved to 0.25 mm, and the comparison at 0.25 mm is the re-recorded stage 0 result, not evidence for this amendment. Amendment 3, before any fit: the radial domain ends at the wall of a 9 cm dish (a declared assumption, reasons in geometry.domain) with 450 cells of 0.1 mm; the window is declared separately as a 40 mm square on which the observables are read; the symmetry check compares the radial model with a 0.25 mm cartesian reference on the window over the leading hours at which at most 0.1 percent of the radial tips lie beyond the window half side, with at least eight compared hours and the unchanged 3 percent threshold. No model term, parameter, bound, operator, hold-out, stage or decision rule changed.

check_values_source: COLONY-001 stage 0 software-check value: an artificial framework value inside the plan's bounds, declared for the grid, solver and symmetry checks; no estimate of either species.
